slides.title: Three decisions determine whether the comparison is useful

cards.heading: A fair split
cards.body: Separate chemistry and target generalization rather than reporting one random split.

cards.heading: An isolated change
cards.body: Hold encoders and training protocol fixed when changing the interaction block.

cards.heading: Evidence beyond AUC
cards.body: Report class imbalance, AUPRC, and error patterns alongside AUROC.
